ra.appendicitis.alt: Paired imaging of a 45-year-old man with source-diagnosed acute appendicitis. ra.appendicitis.source_caption_full: US and CT in acute appendicitis. 45-year-old male patient with pain in the right lower quadrant and increased inflammation parameters (white blood cell count and C-reactive protein elevation).  a  US real-time scan: local pain in combination with some fluid and thickened appendix, only seen in part (between  crosses ).  b  contrast-enhanced CT: thickened appendix, mesenteric infiltration around the appendix, inflammatory thickening of the sigmoid colon
